comparison: Same 2000 training rows, 80 validation rows, seed, 4B base, rank, adapter layers, learning rate and optimizer updates as interpreter-14. Direct binary task has a different prompt and one supervised token; this compares task formulations, not an isolated architecture change.
selection: Minimum complete 80-row validation binary cross-entropy; losses are not comparable to six-field interpreter losses.
screen: Existing 400-row development screen includes the 80 validation rows and is not independent evidence.
prompt: Exact POLICY_V2 used by the unadapted gemma-screen-11 binary reference.
archive_task: Binary review 0/1. The shared interpreter-named archive format stores generic LoRA tensors; its name does not describe this adapter task. Use evaluate_gemma_review_v9 with this policy, never the six-field decoder.
gate: Full development and calibration prerequisites required before any reserved probe or release; no automatic release from this pilot.
